name: Hello, Farewell
effect:
You may play 1 effectless now.

If you do, discard 1 from your trait pile.

name: Nightflower Island
effect:
Draw 2.
Pass 1 from hand left.

name: River Walk
effect:
If you hold 6 or more cards, discard 2 from hand at random.

If you hold 4 or fewer, draw 2.

name: Fatal Falls
effect:
+0 Gene Pool

Randomly discard all but 2 cards from hand.

name: Abandoned
flavor: I used to be in a band...
effect: +1 Gene Pool. If Abandoned is discarded from your trait pile, steal 1 red.

name: Alert
flavor: Maybe a little too ready.
effect: Reveal 2 reds to play at any time.

name: Ancestral
flavor: The best part of the afterlife is judging your kin.
effect: At World's End: You may discard 1 from your trait pile. +3 for each color in your trait pile with exactly 2 traits.

name: Bluesy
flavor: Where did my honey go? I don't nuh-nuh-nuh know.
effect: +1 Gene Pool. At World's End: Discard this.

name: Cairnwalker
flavor: My record is 2,000 stones.
effect: At World's End: Choose a color. Score the face value of traits of that color as 2.

name: Charged
flavor: With great power comes great winnability.
effect: +1 for each unique face value in your trait pile.

name: Concealed
flavor: Why the long face? Because this is the only mask that covers my long face.
effect: Discard a face value of 2 or higher from your trait pile. Then play another trait.

name: Devious
flavor: Mua ha ha ha ha!

name: Distrusted
flavor: Does this mask make me look cunning?
effect: Discard 1 from your trait pile to draw 1. You may play it now.

name: Dryadic
flavor: Good things come in trees.
effect: -2 for each purple trait in your trait pile. +1 for each green. +1 for each red.

name: Entwined
flavor: Everything's vine.
effect: Play at any time: Discard 1 from your trait pile. (Excluding dominants, this can stop the trait from being swapped/stolen.)

name: Excluded
flavor: I guess I'll just sit in this corner and wait for someone to talk to me then.
effect: Draw 4. If Excluded is discarded from your trait pile, draw 4.

name: Facekeeper
flavor: Just one of the guise.
effect: At World's End: You may discard up to 3 from your trait pile. Then reveal 1 from the top of the trait deck for each trait discarded this way. Add their face values to your final score.

name: Feared
flavor: Please stop running! Help me get this mask off!
effect: Discard 1 from your trait pile, and 1 from hand.

name: Feng Shui
flavor: Everything is balanced. As long as I win.
effect: Discard a face value 3 or higher from hand to play another trait.

name: Gravetender
flavor: This job is beneath me.
effect: At World's End: Draw 1 for each color missing from your trait pile. +2 for each card drawn this way.

name: Honor
flavor: I'm not a thief, I'm a pirate. Now give me that.
effect: Choose an opponent. They choose to give you: 2 cards from hand OR 1 random card.

name: Jacked
flavor: Never skip chop day.
effect: To play, you must have 3 greens in your trait pile. Discard 1 red in hand to reduce the requirement to 2 greens.

name: Jejune
flavor: Why are you so deep and serious? Just have some fun already!
effect: At World's End: Change up to 4 traits in your trait pile to colorless.

name: Lode
flavor: Don't take this gem for granite.
effect: Choose a color. Draw 5. Discard the chosen color from the drawn cards.

name: Low Mane
flavor: This needs flavor.
effect: All players may stabilize to 5. Then you may reveal 2 of the same color to play another trait.

name: Mini
flavor: So small, you might miss the big heart.

name: Misfortune
flavor: I see things happening to you in the future.
effect: At World's End: +2 for each trait discarded from your trait pile during the final catastrophe.

name: Nurturing
flavor: The secret is love and fertilizer.
effect: At World's End: Draw 1. You may discard a face value 1 from your trait pile to play another trait. Ignore its action.

name: Palmate
flavor: I ain't your pal, mate. Don't moose with me.

name: Pompadour
flavor: This year, I'm going to take the best yearbook picture.
effect: To play, you must discard: 1 from your trait pile OR 1 negative from an opponent's trait pile.

name: Rejected
flavor: Get outta town! No, seriously, you need to leave.
effect: Play 1. If Rejected is removed from your trait pile, increase your Gene Pool by 1.

name: Restorative
flavor: I'm the only doctor in town, so come back tomorrow if you'd like a second opinion.
effect: All players may discard 0-3 cards from hand, then stabilize.

name: Scratchy Feet
flavor: Moving forward, itch by itch.

name: Shunned
flavor: You cry wolf three times, and suddenly no one will help you.
effect: +5 if this is your only purple. If Shunned is discarded from your trait pile, you may play up to 2 purples. Ignore actions.

name: Silence
effect: Opponents ignore actions on their next turn. But you must remind them.

name: Smithy
flavor: Respect your welders.
effect: Reveal: 2 greens: Play 1 green. 2 reds: Discard 1 from your trait pile.

name: Smooth
flavor: Hitting the right notes is optional.
effect: Play at any time to draw 1. At World's End: Discard this.

name: Stargazer
flavor: Just here for the view.

name: Steady
flavor: I urn for more.
effect: Draw 2. Then reveal 4 different colors to draw 2.

name: Subdued
flavor: Is it time for my solo?
effect: Play 1. At World's End: Discard this.

name: Sundering
flavor: Speak its name and it shall be no more.
effect: Start of your turns: Choose a color. If you have traits of that color in your trait pile, discard them.

name: Swarm of Kidneys
flavor: We're here for the new hats.
effect: Value is equal to the number of Kidney traits in all trait piles. (Including this one.)

name: Teeny
flavor: Weddle eddle, tinsie winsie.
effect: If you have 11 or fewer traits in your trait pile, triple the face value of all your dominants.

name: Unusual
flavor: The way I see it, in this world, it is the usual that is unusual!
effect: Play 1. If Unusual is removed from your trait pile, play 1 effectless.

name: Veiled
flavor: When the wind picks up, wave your arms around like you are doing magic.
effect: In any order, discard 1 from your trait pile, and play the top of the discard pile. Ignore actions.

name: Virtuoso
flavor: If you're going to master an instrument, let it be the master of all instruments.
effect: Swap Virtuoso with a face value 3 or higher from an opponent's trait pile. At World's End: Discard this.

name: Warning Signals
flavor: Some things should really just have red flags painted on their bodies.
